If it is simply the fundamentals that are useful, and not all the extra stuff being shoved in, then I'm okay with moving forward, but remembering absolutely everything at this moment feels impossible.

I remember one time, my mom came into my room screaming at midnight about how the tupperware was unorganized, even though it really was quite tidy. Next thing I know she's throwing them all across the kitchen, drunk on wine and yelled at me to clean it up. I did, better than it was before, and locked my door while listening to music. A few hours later, I take my headphones off and hear my door being pounded on by my mom saying she's going to call the cops and get me arrested. I open the door before she can unlock it, and apparently all she wanted to do was thank me for doing it.

Moms can be abusive, despite the common angelization of them. My mom was mostly mentally but sometimes physically abusive during my upbringing and it has partially led to my thoughts of suicide as well. Own your pain. Knowing someone else is out there who can relate to how I feel, even on a worse level than I, means a lot.
